walkthrough: Goal: choose the picture of a long colour copy myself, rename a copy or delete it; keep my own pictures in order (see them, say how hard each is to copy, delete one I no longer want, knowing what that leaves); on a session's sheet, undo only what I did on the exercise in front of me; and have a coloured value scale judged by lightness as my eye sees it.

Pictures of my own: in the gallery, the Today card's options. Add my picture… first asks how hard it is to copy (Entry, Simple, Medium, Hard, each with what it holds); I tap Entry and the picture picker opens; I choose a picture. The options now show My pictures with how many; tapped, it lists each picture small with its tier and whether it has an outline. Tapping one shows it larger with its tier as four words; I move it to Medium. Its bin asks before it deletes it.

A copy of a picture I choose: New copy… shows a picker: the tiers as words and My pictures, the chosen tier's pictures as rows, each small with its title and its credit; a picture copied before says so. I choose Medium and the vase: the copy begins, the vase beside an empty frame of its shape. I paint a stroke and go back to the gallery. The options list 'Colour copy 1' with the vase small beside it and its options button.

Rename and delete: the copy's options button shows its page: the vase larger with its title and credit, Open, Rename… and Delete…. Rename… opens the naming dialog; I type 'Vase study'; the page shows the new name, so does the list. Delete… asks 'Delete “Vase study”?': my painting on it goes for good, its picture stays. Delete: the copy is gone from the list.

Deleting a picture a copy used: I begin a copy of my own picture (New copy…, My pictures) and paint on it. Back in My pictures its bin asks 'Delete “Picture 1”?' and says what that leaves: no session and one colour copy used it; they keep my strokes and where it lay they say 'Picture deleted'. Delete. The copy stays in the list, 'Picture deleted' beside it; opened, its frames are where they were, my stroke is there, the original's frame says 'Picture deleted' and Compare is greyed.

Undo on a session's sheet: Stage 2 · Single shapes starts a session; I pass it to its end and take One more. On the first shape I draw a line and Compare; Next. On the second shape I draw a line and undo it; Undo then does nothing more: the first shape's line and its Compare stay. Redo brings my line back.

A coloured value scale: on to the session's value scale, a hue this time. I pick its dark end with the eyedropper, then in the wheel's square move only up for lighter cells, a cell at a time with Fill cell. Compare: the original's frame shows the even scale in lightness as the eye sees it, hue held; the bars under my row show each cell's lightness against its even step; the card names the cells off. In Chinese the card reads the same.
Not here: renaming or deleting from the canvas; a picture's own title; sorting the picker.
